title: Joint Modeling of Conditional Mean and Variability in Multilevel Functional Data: Application to Postprandial Glucose Trajectories in the AEGIS Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.07937v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Functional data analysis provides a framework for studying time-varying associations between covariates and high-frequency biological signals. In digital health, participants often contribute repeated functional trajectories, yet existing multilevel regression methods largely focus on the conditional mean, overlooking variability and its role in biological heterogeneity. We propose a heteroskedastic functional mixed-effects regression framework that jointly models the conditional mean and variance of repeated trajectories, with participant-specific random effects in both components. We also develop a participant-level bootstrap to quantify uncertainty in estimated functional parameters. We apply the method to postprandial glucose trajectories from the AEGIS study. translated_title: 多水平函数数据中条件均值与变异性的联合建模：在AEGIS研究餐后血糖轨迹中的应用
translated_abstract: 函数数据分析为研究协变量与高频生物信号之间的时变关联提供了框架。在数字健康领域，参与者通常会贡献重复的函数轨迹，然而现有的多水平回归方法主要关注条件均值，忽视了变异性及其在生物异质性中的作用。我们提出了一种异方差函数混合效应回归框架，联合建模重复轨迹的条件均值与方差，并在两个成分中都引入了参与者特定的随机效应。我们还开发了一种参与者层面的自助法（bootstrap）来量化估计的函数参数的不确定性。我们将该方法应用于AEGIS研究中的餐后血糖轨迹数据。结果显示，餐前血糖、碳水化合物摄入量以及餐食类型与血糖变异性呈现出明显不同的时依赖关联，而HbA1c则与条件均值关联更强。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种异方差函数混合效应回归框架，联合建模多水平重复函数轨迹的条件均值与方差，并通过参与者层面的自助法量化参数不确定性，应用于AEGIS研究揭示了各因素对餐后血糖均值与变异性的时依赖差异化影响。
